summary.prose: The work adds a small store that copies pasted images and picked documents into a per-chat folder under ~/.insrc/chat-attachments, then teaches the chat host to keep a pending list per chat and send it with the next message as file paths the CLI may read. The panel gains an icon-only attach button under the prompt, removable chips, image paste, and chips on sent messages that open the file. Three review findings accepted by override are built in as explicit behaviour: only a real submit takes attachments, an attachment-only submit supersedes queued approvals, and a submit is tied to the chat it started in. The recorded limits are 20 MB per file, 10 per message and PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP for pasted images; drag-and-drop and image previews in the transcript are out of scope.

tasks.title: Host: sending attachments with a message
tasks.summary: chat-panel.ts. Only the submit-turn caller takes the pending attachments: runTurn gains an explicit attachments argument that the submit-turn case fills, and the grant re-run and the selection continuation pass none (review finding). The submit-turn case supersedes queued approvals when the text is non-blank OR attachments are pending (review finding). The session and its pending list are captured before waiting for in-flight attachment writes; if the active session changed or the panel closed during the wait the submit is dropped and the attachments stay pending on their session; a second submit waits its turn behind the first (review finding). The user row stores the user's text with the attachments and user-row echoes them; the prompt sent to the CLI ends with the attached-files block of absolute paths; readDirs carries the session's attachments directory on this turn and on every later turn of a session whose transcript holds an attachment, including grant re-runs and selection continuations; a first message with blank text names the chat from its first attachment.
